title: save_story
description: Persist the active story to the filesystem as Twee source and (by default) compile to Twine 2 HTML via extwee. Creates the sibling assets/<story-slug>/ directory if missing so image placeholders have a ready drop zone.

output_dir.description: Absolute or process-cwd-relative directory. Files written: <output_dir>/<story-slug>.twee and (if compile_html) <output_dir>/<story-slug>.html, plus <output_dir>/assets/<story-slug>/ directory.

compile_html.description: When true, emit a playable HTML bundled with the story format's runtime via extwee.

overwrite.description: When false, refuse to overwrite existing files and surface a clarification.

assets_dir.description: The assets/<story-slug>/ directory; created empty if it did not exist.

pending_image_drops.description: One entry per image placeholder whose expected file is not yet present on disk.

clarification_triggers: output_dir missing AND no prior save: ask for the destination folder
target file exists AND overwrite=false: ask overwrite | pick_new_dir | cancel
acceptance_test_hooks: US1 scenario 1–3: saved HTML opens in browser and in Twine 2 editor with identical graph
US3 scenario 2: assets_dir is created so the author's image drop path is valid immediately
